holdout: one frozen finalist per deck may be evaluated only after development freeze; no post-holdout tuning
holdout_multiple_comparisons: Holm correction across the two frozen deck finalists for holdout recommendation-status inference; no finalist reselection after holdout

holdout_recommendation_gate.interpretation: all thresholds apply only to structural-model holdout evidence; failure means not supported for recommendation, not evidence the real deck is worse

multiple_comparisons: Holm family-wise correction per deck search family

preselection.rationale: exclude structurally severe role/profile regressions before costly stochastic comparison

truth_boundary: all effects and p-values are model-internal structural simulation quantities, not empirical Commander results
